scene: The cat leads you to the Grand Junction transit platform.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left, a sleek glass-roofed trolley rests at its platform. The player stands left of centre, in lilac headscarf and mustard coat with brown satchel, watching the calico cat trot past a brass spiral lift standing in the centre. On the far right waits a red mountain cable tram.
shown: a waiting glass-roofed trolley with an open door on the left
a brass spiral lift shaft with a waiting car in the centre
a steep mountain cable tram idling with doors open on the right

variants.scene: The tabby strolls onto the platform beside three strange, glowing rides.
Lanterns hum in the twilight while you wonder about {quest}.
Warm station lamps glow as trains and a tall brass lift await.
